primaryArchetype.title: The Strategist
primaryArchetype.subtitle: The Architect of Order & Long-Range Foresight
primaryArchetype.tagline: Anticipating the future three moves ahead through structured analysis.
primaryArchetype.shortDescription: You possess a methodical mind that sees patterns where others see chaos. You design sustainable systems, prioritize long-term leverage over immediate gratification, and excel at translating high-level vision into clear operating steps.
primaryArchetype.fullDescription: The Strategist moves through the world like a chess grandmaster. You are rarely caught unprepared because your mind constantly runs scenario simulations. You value intellectual precision, structural durability, and emotional calm. In team settings, you bring needed gravity and composure, preventing impulsive decisions. While others celebrate immediate wins, you are already architecting the infrastructure for the year ahead.
superpowers: Uncanny ability to deconstruct complex dilemmas into actionable sequences
Remarkable emotional composure during high-stakes uncertainty
Natural foresight that identifies hidden risks before they materialize
Deep respect for sustainable architecture over temporary hacks
blindspots: Can become paralyzed by analysis when quick empirical action is needed
May dismiss intuitive or emotional perspectives as irrational
Tendency to appear emotionally distant or overly detached in intimate conversations
Frustration with colleagues who do not plan methodically
primaryArchetype.communicationStyle: Clear, structured, and economy-driven. Prefers well-organized arguments, bullet points, and data-backed rationale rather than emotional rhetoric.
primaryArchetype.collaborationStyle: Excels as the strategic anchor or project architect. Works best when granted autonomy to map the trajectory before execution begins.
primaryArchetype.idealEnvironment: Quiet, high-trust environments that value thoughtful deliberation, clear ownership, and measurable benchmarks over frantic reactive urgency.
primaryArchetype.growthLever: Embrace 'good enough' speed. Learn to make directional decisions with 70% information rather than waiting for 95% certainty.

secondaryArchetype.title: The Analyst
secondaryArchetype.subtitle: The Seeker of Empirical Truth & First Principles
secondaryArchetype.tagline: Stripping away emotional biases to uncover objective reality and causal mechanisms.
secondaryArchetype.shortDescription: You are driven by an unquenchable quest for intellectual accuracy and objective clarity. You deconstruct claims, verify evidence, and base decisions on rigorous first principles.
secondaryArchetype.fullDescription: The Analyst does not accept assumptions at face value. While others are swayed by charismatic narratives or emotional appeals, you demand the underlying data, the causal mechanics, and the sample size. You possess a sharp, disciplined intellect capable of untangling complex mathematical, technical, or systemic knots. Your honesty is refreshing, and your analytical rigor protects projects from costly delusions.
superpowers: Uncompromising intellectual integrity and logical deconstruction
Mastery of quantitative, scientific, and structural modeling
Immunity to hype, social contagion, and superficial marketing claims
Deep diagnostic capability for finding root causes rather than symptoms
blindspots: Can come across as hyper-critical, skeptical, or emotionally cold
Dismisses non-quantifiable emotional factors that nonetheless drive human decisions
Analysis paralysis when attempting to model fundamentally unpredictable human systems
Difficulty communicating complex findings to non-technical audiences
secondaryArchetype.communicationStyle: Precise, objective, factual, and analytical. Uses clear definitions, nuances, probabilities, and supporting data.
secondaryArchetype.collaborationStyle: The technical conscience and diagnostic brain. Excels in auditing, architecture, research, quantitative modeling, and risk evaluation.
secondaryArchetype.idealEnvironment: Meritocratic, fact-based teams where ideas are evaluated on evidence rather than hierarchy or charisma.
secondaryArchetype.growthLever: Integrate psychological and human realities into your logic. People are not algorithms; empathy is an essential dimension of total truth.
